text:
Hi hiring team,

I am writing to express my interest in the AI Engineer Intern role at Northwind Analytics. As a Computer Science undergraduate at Pune Institute of Technology with hands-on machine learning experience, I am eager to contribute to your team. 

During my recent internship at Brightcart Retail Analytics, I built a retrieval-augmented chatbot over 4,000 product manuals using Python, FastAPI, and pgvector. I also created an evaluation set of 150 questions and improved answer accuracy from 71% to 86% through prompt and chunk size tuning. 

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background aligns with your needs for this internship. Thank you for your time and consideration.

Best regards,

Alex Rao
